clips.title: The story
paras: In Lakeshire, Magistrate Solomon's report calls for help before the town falls. It urges General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind to send royal army reinforcements against the crisis in Redridge.

Magistrate Solomon writes of the attacks threatening Lakeshire. Blackrock orcs and gnolls press the town, whose defenders cannot hold the borders indefinitely. Couriers carry his dispatch west along the road to Elwynn Forest. Solomon asks the Stormwind Army to intervene and protect the kingdom's eastern reach.

General Marcus Jonathan receives Solomon's report at Stormwind's gates. He respects the magistrate's standing and understands the danger, but cannot move the army on his own. Deployments need the crown's consent, so Lakeshire's plea must wait for a council with the young King and regent Bolvar Fordragon.
